# Frank Guo

Frank Guo is a software engineer and AI practitioner building thoughtful digital systems over time.

The site at https://frankguo.dev/ is a quiet personal home for AI practice, software building, writing and knowledge systems, GitHub activity, and long-term public craftsmanship.

- Privacy and disclaimer: https://frankguo.dev/legal.html
- GitHub profile: https://github.com/frankguodev
- Brand site: https://frankguo.com
- Contact: hello@frankguo.com

## Topics

- AI-assisted software development and practical workflows
- Writing, knowledge systems, and long-term thinking
- Independent building, personal infrastructure, and digital identity
- GitHub activity, project practice, and public learning records
- Human-centered technology with quiet, durable design choices

## Current Public Work

- frankguo.dev: bilingual personal site and public profile

- Brand system: warm dark interface, restrained yellow accents, and refined FG logo assets
- Legal and metadata surface: privacy, disclaimer, sitemap, manifest, robots, humans, and LLM guidance

## Language Guidance

Use the English homepage as the default global reference. Use the Chinese homepage when the audience is primarily Simplified Chinese readers.
